description: Browser-based space RPG/strategy. TypeScript + PixiJS 8 + onnxruntime-web. Local ONNX models for dialogue and tactical AI.

layers.name: Presentation
layers.responsibility: PixiJS scenes, sprites, rendering, player input

layers.name: Systems
layers.responsibility: GameEngine, AudioManager, trade, dialogue, galaxy generation; sub-modules: equipment/, npc/, quests/, info/, combat/, galaxy/

layers.name: Domain
layers.responsibility: Pure entities (Player, Galaxy, StarSystem) — no PixiJS/ONNX/DOM deps

layers.name: AI/Infrastructure
layers.responsibility: ONNX inference, Web Workers, IndexedDB, save management

layers.name: Types/Config
layers.responsibility: Shared types, enums, balance constants. FactionType replaces old RaceType.

dependency_rule: Strict top -> bottom only. A lower layer must never import from a higher one.

key_entry_points.src/main.ts: App entry: Service Worker registration, GameEngine initialization
key_entry_points.src/systems/GameEngine.ts: Central engine: scene transitions, game loop, save coordination
key_entry_points.src/presentation/GameScene.ts: Base scene class: initialize(), update(dt), destroy()
key_entry_points.src/core/services/SceneFactory.ts: Maps SceneType enum -> concrete scene instance
key_entry_points.src/types/index.ts: SceneType, QuestType, FactionType and all shared enums/types
key_entry_points.src/config/balance.ts: BALANCE, GAME_BALANCE, SYSTEM_GEOMETRY and balance constants
key_entry_points.src/validation/schemas.ts: Zod schemas mirroring domain types — save-game validation

lockstep_rules.trigger: Add a domain field (src/types/index.ts or src/domain/*.ts)
must_also_touch: src/validation/schemas.ts (add matching Zod field — else saves break)
src/data/MigrationPipeline.ts (add a migration if old saves need it)
src/systems/GameEngine.ts contextDependentScenes (if scene needs transient context)
20+ files across quests/, generators, UI — no generator yet (future work)

onnx_rule: Never call ort.InferenceSession.run() on main thread — use ONNXModelRegistry.infer(). Models load lazily -> cached in IndexedDB -> inference runs in Web Workers only.
errors_rule: Throw only GameBusinessException, GameSystemException, GameValidationException, or InferenceException (src/exceptions/). Use src/utils/logger.ts, never console.log.
texture_rule: Heavy art categories (panoramas/, surfaces/, planet_maps/, star_maps/, stars/, nebula/) are in LAZY_PREFIXES — load via pickVariantKey + loadTextureAsync, not synchronous pickVariant.
